description: React hook 'useForecast' to fetch and manage 5-day weather forecast data with loading, error, and data states. Uses useEffect for side-effects and handles auto-cancellation with AbortController.

methods.name: useForecast(city, options = {})
methods.description: Custom React hook to fetch weather forecast data for a specified city with support for options such as number of days, and manages fetch status, data, and errors.

methods.name: refetch
methods.description: Function to manually trigger a refetch; currently a no-op but can be extended for manual refresh.
